LanguageData.DCP_Intro: While a drafted player-controlled pawn is executing an explicit player-forced job, ordinary autonomous jobs cannot replace it.
LanguageData.DCP_EnableDesc: When enabled, a drafted pawn's current player-forced job cannot be replaced by a non-player-forced StartJob request.
LanguageData.DCP_MeleeAutoAttackDesc: Drafted player-controlled pawns holding a melee weapon automatically attack a nearby hostile pawn when they have no player-forced order.
LanguageData.DCP_MeleeAutoAttackRadiusDesc: Sets the maximum straight-line distance for automatic melee target acquisition. Range: 1-20 cells. Default: 4.
LanguageData.DCP_LogBlockedDesc: Developer diagnostic option. Logs each blocked StartJob request. Leave off during normal play.
LanguageData.DCP_BlockedCount: Blocked autonomous job replacements this session: {0}
LanguageData.DCP_AutoAttackCount: Automatic melee attack jobs started this session: {0}
